runtime_sql_contract.source: Java adapter runtime SQL manifest exported before capture
runtime_sql_contract.join: questions LEFT JOIN subjects on q.subject_id = s.id

parameters.raw_and_nullable_distribution: fixed public edge rows plus sparse deterministic nulls

index_definitions.name: ix_questions_subject_id
index_definitions.definition: CREATE INDEX ix_questions_subject_id ON public.questions USING btree (subject_id)

index_definitions.name: questions_pkey
index_definitions.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX questions_pkey ON public.questions USING btree (id)

index_definitions.name: subjects_pkey
index_definitions.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX subjects_pkey ON public.subjects USING btree (id)

index_boundary.statement: ix_questions_subject_id exists only in the isolated fixture to observe PG18.4 choices; it does not approve a production index or migration.

measurement.command: execute and EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) each exact Java runtime SELECT through PREPARE/EXECUTE
measurement.subject_relation_loop_contract: exact distinct-key memoized probes for all rows; exact zero-or-one probe for filtered rows

removed: sample-dependent planner costs and row estimates
redacted: planner filter, join, sort, and index expressions with SHA-256 retained
retained: relation, join type, and observed index names

interpretation.statement: This isolated PostgreSQL 18.4 capture closes ten-column row shape, result digests, signed and nullable edges, strict ascending order, typed binds, one outer join, one scan of each relation, bounded loops, and zero TEMP for the exact Java SQL. It is not a production latency, capacity, or index-approval claim.

reproduction.prerequisites: Docker and the repository Maven verification image
reproduction.isolation: ephemeral network-disabled container removed on success or failure
